comment: X5 physical pins 32/33 were checked against controller 34170000.pwm, channels 0/1, currently pwmchip0. Numbering may change after reboot: real mode verifies the resolved controller. Do not use 34110000.lpwm (camera sync, currently pwmchip2). Pulse/angle examples are NOT calibration. Pump is disabled until its actual GPIO/polarity are configured. PWM/GPIO may remain active after process crash; use a hardware emergency stop/pump interlock.
